sloka: लब्ध शब्देन कौसल्ये कुमारेण धनुष्मता ।कुमारः शब्द वेधी इति मया पापम् इदम् कृतम् ॥२-६३-११॥
transliteration: labdha śabdena kausalye kumāreṇa dhanuṣmatā ।kumāraḥ śabda vedhī iti mayā pāpam idam kṛtam ॥2-63-11॥

translations.english: O Kausalya in my youth I was a great archer who could hit the target by its sound. As such I committed this sin.
